why: The headline issue #245 defect: a developer session's WRITES land on the production keys, so a dev level jump, sandbox event or achievement check overwrites the real player's campaign. Only setItem is unnamespaced here -- reads still go through the prefix -- which is what makes it destructive rather than obviously broken: the developer session boots at defaults, writes over the player's save, and nothing in that session ever displays the collision. 10 of 40 tests in storage.test.ts, spanning the write/read-back pair, removeItem and clear scoping, enumeration, injectivity, the whole-inventory sweep, the reload round trip and the save.ts export/import case. The wide population is the point rather than noise: every property the adapter exists to provide is downstream of setItem landing in the right namespace.
